Annotators were instructed to assess whether the generated misinformation logically supports the claim (Entailment) and whether it contradicts the correct evidence (Conflict).

Entailment Check: Determining whether the generated misinformation logically supports the corresponding claim. Conflict Check: Determining whether the generated factual, temporal and semantic misinformation contradict with the correct evidence text.
